verification.self_critique: Concurrency tested with threads only (4 x 5 rounds), not separate processes; threads each use their own connection so the lock path was exercised, but timing is not guaranteed to overlap. Under a non-UTC database zone, old versus new output differs only for the offsetless legacy value (old echoed raw text, new normalizes), which is expected and not a regression for app-written data. Docker volume migration and the real database were deliberately not touched. The non-UTC pytest tests rely on PGOPTIONS; I confirmed the zone effect independently via ALTER DATABASE.
